init.title: NEM PD7DAY Options
init.description: Forecasts are fetched at {fetch_times} NEM time (AEST). Loss factor: the library's default is {library_loss_factor}; Amber's current settled feed-in interval shows {amber_loss_factor}.

data.only_active_tariff: Enable only the active tariff's sensors
data.local_price_diagnostic: Add the DUID local price diagnostic

data_description.amber_forecast_entity: Leave empty: the day 2-7 series starts where the Amber Electric or Amber Express forecast ends, found automatically. Choose one Amber forecast sensor only to use it alone, for example when two Amber sites are installed. With no Amber integration it starts by the clock.
data_description.active_tariff: Automatic: the tariff your Amber site reports (Amber Express site sensor), else the region's default. The day 2-7 tariff sensors follow it.
data_description.only_active_tariff: On: the region's other tariff sensors are disabled, so only the active tariff and its export tariff update. Applies only when the tariff is chosen here or reported by Amber. A sensor you enable yourself is left on.
data_description.local_price_duids: Optional. DUIDs, comma separated, for example GSTONE1, CATHROCK. For each, a sensor of its dispatch local price adjustment and one of the 5-minute pre-dispatch forecast are added. Empty, none are made and the P5MIN file is never fetched. A DUID is a geographic signal, not your connection point's price.
data_description.local_price_diagnostic: Also add a Local Price sensor per DUID: the region's original price plus the adjustment, between the market floor and cap. A diagnostic, not a regional, retail or settlement price.
data_description.loss_factor: Optional. One factor spot is scaled by in every tariff price, import and export, in place of the library's Energex defaults. Amber prices an Energex site at 1.0272. Outside an export charge or credit window, Amber's settled feed-in interval shows your site's factor (above). Empty uses the library's defaults.

error.invalid_duid: A DUID is up to ten letters, digits or underscores.
